verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS transcription API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export of account data, no export of transcripts in open formats, and no offboarding path. The data-retention TTL and model-training opt-out are adjacent privacy controls, not export, and the per-request API responses are building blocks rather than a capability to export all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
